notes_and_caveats.conservative_estimates: All estimates use slower rates appropriate for publication-quality work. Actual commercial projects often use faster rates with lower quality gates.
notes_and_caveats.stress_verification_critical: The most time-consuming and expertise-critical phase is stress verification. Russian stress is unpredictable and cannot be reliably guessed - requires dictionary lookup for each word.
notes_and_caveats.poetry_vs_prose: Poetry composition rates are 5-10x slower than prose due to meter, rhyme, and form constraints. Technical verse is even more demanding.
notes_and_caveats.framework_value: The 90K+ lines of frameworks represent extraordinary value - comparable projects without frameworks take 50-100% longer.
notes_and_caveats.ai_acceleration: The 77-hour AI-assisted timeline is remarkable but still requires native expertise for final polish. AI excels at synthesis and generation; humans excel at refinement and cultural nuance.
